scores.rationale: Each phase explicitly orders the highest-rework/widest-impact task first (time-zone checks, network names, dependency mapping).

scores.evidence: "Application Insights traces each request with an ID... dashboard shows copy delay, probe match rate and latency at each layer"

scores.evidence: "Terraform or Bicep from git, through a pipeline. No manual changes in the Azure portal."
